hadith:
Prophetic Commentary on the Qur'an (Tafseer of the Prophet (pbuh)) - Narrated `Abdullah:

The Prophet (ﷺ) said one statement and I said another. The Prophet (ﷺ) said "Whoever dies while still invoking anything other than Allah as a rival to Allah, will enter Hell (Fire)." And I said, "Whoever dies without invoking anything as a rival to Allah, will enter Paradise."
message: The Striking Disaster reminds us that this life is not the end, so turn sincerely to Allah and worship Him alone. Trust that harm and benefit are under His authority, and seek His guidance through every hardship.
name:
Ad Daarr - الضَّارَّ - The Distresser

Ad Daarr is understood alongside An Naafi', relating hardship and benefit to Allah's authority. Quran 6:17 and 10:107 describe His power over harm and good. The Arabic root is ض ر ر; the explanation does not attribute injustice or aimless harm to Allah.
verse:
Al-Qari'ah - The Calamity - 101:1

The Striking Disaster!
